Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per our renewal timeline, Ive sketched a minimal plan that combines the EU edge activation you requested (data residency + onshore inference node) with an APAC hot-standby that will accept traffic in failover scenarios. High-level asks:

- Activate EU dedicated edge node (single-tenant) by Oct 1, 2026
- APAC hot-standby (warm) for regional failover, available 24/7 for critical traffic
- 25% uplift in committed seats for the first 3 months post-cutover to handle burst testing

Hi Lena, Markus,

Attaching a draft Statement of Work (SOW-2026-06-BrightCare.pdf) and a capacity/pricing CSV. Key answers inline:

- EU edge RTO: our standard plan targets a 10-minute DNS and routing cutover for single-region failover; full warming is typically 30-45 minutes for large KV-backed workloads. We can offer an accelerated cutover run (blue-green) as part of the activation sprint.
- APAC hot-standby behavior: warm-standby with periodic KV snapshot replication. On failover we replay recent prefixes from cache + on-demand re-warm. Were recommending a 15-minute warm window for predictable performance.
- 25% uplift: see capacity-pricing-2026.csv (attached) for the month-by-month cost delta vs current commitment.

Attachments: SOW-2026-06-BrightCare.pdf (draft, 6 pages), capacity-pricing-2026.csv
